meanings.meaning: A skin condition, usually of the face, that is common in adolescents. It is characterised by red pimples, and is caused by the inflammation of sebaceous glands through bacterial infection; acne vulgaris.
examples: He struggled with severe acne during his teenage years.
The dermatologist prescribed a cream to treat her acne.

meanings.meaning: A pattern of blemishes in an area of skin resulting from the skin condition.
Any of several other skin conditions that resemble acne vulgaris.
